name: Tetuko (´∀｀)
source:
The Witch, a phantom wizard-based max class. Witch is the name given to the first magic master who slays a dragon on the continent.

Her style of play is first-rate, and she is a master. Her calm judgment and firepower at the critical moment are both formidable.

She met the protagonist, because of the “iron” character in his name, she said to him, “Don't imitate me!"

She knows the game inside and out, and likes to bully beginners.

Name Offline: Misaki Renka
Level: 44 >> 52
Attribute: Darkness
Class: Beginner >> Magician >> Magic Master (Witch)

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/online/character/renka.htm]official site[/url]]
